description: Unit tests for Android network library functions in Chromium project, testing network capabilities, DNS, WiFi signal levels, and network binding.

methods.name: NetworkLibraryTest.CaptivePortal
methods.description: Tests if the device is detected as having a captive portal.

methods.name: NetworkLibraryTest.GetWifiSignalLevel
methods.description: Tests retrieval and validation of WiFi signal level.

methods.name: NetworkLibraryTest.GetDnsSearchDomains
methods.description: Tests retrieval of DNS search domains on Android, skipping pre-Marshmallow.

methods.name: NetworkLibraryTest.GetDnsSearchDomainsForNetwork
methods.description: Tests retrieval of DNS search domains for a specific network, skipping pre-P.

methods.name: NetworkLibraryTest.BindToNetwork
methods.description: Tests binding sockets to networks, including valid and invalid handles.
